sources.content:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from flash_attn import flash_attn_func
import flashinfer.norm


@torch.no_grad()
def run(
    hidden_state,
    input_layernorm_weight, input_layernorm_bias,
    q_proj_weight, k_proj_weight, v_proj_weight, o_proj_weight,
    post_attention_layernorm_weight, post_attention_layernorm_bias,
    fc1_weight, fc1_bias, fc2_weight, fc2_bias,
    gate_attn, gate_ffn,
    norm_eps,
):
    batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size = hidden_state.shape
    num_heads = 16
    head_dim = hidden_size // num_heads
    scaling = head_dim ** -0.5

    # === Self-attention block ===
    residual = hidden_state

    # LayerNorm via FlashInfer
    x_flat = hidden_state.reshape(-1, hidden_size).contiguous()
    hidden_state = flashinfer.norm.layernorm(
        x_flat, input_layernorm_weight, input_layernorm_bias, norm_eps
    ).reshape(batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)

    # QKV projection
    query = F.linear(hidden_state, q_proj_weight)
    key = F.linear(hidden_state, k_proj_weight)
    value = F.linear(hidden_state, v_proj_weight)

    # FlashAttention format: [batch, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim]
    query = query.view(batch_size, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim).contiguous()
    key = key.view(batch_size, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim).contiguous()
    value = value.view(batch_size, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim).contiguous()

    # FlashAttention (non-causal vision attention)
    attn_output = flash_attn_func(query, key, value, causal=False, softmax_scale=scaling)
    attn_output = attn_output.reshape(batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)

    attn_output = F.linear(attn_output, o_proj_weight)

    # Gated residual
    hidden_state = residual + torch.tanh(gate_attn) * attn_output

    # === MLP block ===
    residual = hidden_state

    # Post-attn LayerNorm
    x_flat = hidden_state.reshape(-1, hidden_size).contiguous()
    hidden_state = flashinfer.norm.layernorm(
        x_flat, post_attention_layernorm_weight, post_attention_layernorm_bias, norm_eps
    ).reshape(batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size)

    # MLP with GELU
    hidden_state = F.linear(hidden_state, fc1_weight, fc1_bias)
    hidden_state = F.gelu(hidden_state)
    hidden_state = F.linear(hidden_state, fc2_weight, fc2_bias)

    output = residual + torch.tanh(gate_ffn) * hidden_state
    return output
